clue.text: Oriental princess in silent film

indicators.note: the princess and the Oriental are placed within the word for silent

parts.note: to keep mum is to stay silent
E is short for East, the Orient
Di, the familiar name of Princess Diana

explanation.surface: An Eastern princess appears in a silent movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like the cinema of the surface, but it is the definition: film, like radio or print, is a means of expression.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinema is an artistic medium, a channel through which stories are told.

clue.text: Something to read in the powder room

explanation.surface: Someone takes a periodical along to the ladies' loo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Powder room' suggests a lavatory, but a magazine is also a store for gunpowder.
explanation.definitionFit: A periodical publication to read, and a military storehouse for explosives and ammunition.

clue.text: Doesn't pay for a new flat, sued

indicators.note: the letters of flat and sued are made new, put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A tenant withholds money after being sued over a new flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To default is to fail to meet a payment that is owed.

clue.text: Employed to collect various dues

indicators.note: the letters of dues are put in a varied, different order

explanation.surface: A worker is hired to gather assorted fees.
explanation.definitionFit: Something employed has been put to use.

clue.text: Fast trip crossing town

indicators.note: to trip is to stumble, so the letters of fast fall into disorder

parts.note: a ford is a shallow river crossing

explanation.surface: A quick journey takes in a town on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: STAF, the anagram of FAST signalled by 'trip', comes before FORD. Stafford is the county town of Staffordshire in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Stafford is an English county town, an example of the category.

clue.text: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad

definitions.text: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad

parts.words: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad
parts.note: reads like a motorist facing a magistrate, but the court is one for a ball game and the driving is a powerful forehand stroke

explanation.surface: A reckless motorist will be punished by the magistrates.
explanation.definitionFit: A player on the court loses points when the drives they hit go astray.

clue.text: No success at keeping a girl quiet

parts.note: Flo is a girl's name, short for Florence
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone fails in an attempt to keep a young woman silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A flop is a failure, the opposite of a hit.

clue.text: Fancy becoming a tenor maybe

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of a tenor could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A singer imagines being promoted to the tenor section.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancy as an adjective means elaborate or decorated.

clue.text: He picks the winning ticket but returns the prize

indicators.note: returns tells us the word for the prize is written back to front

parts.note: a reward is a prize

explanation.surface: The person conducting a raffle draws the winner but hands the prize back.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who draws a ticket from the hat in a raffle.

clue.text: Senior electrician in the studio puts a mistake right

parts.note: a gaffe is a blunder

explanation.surface: The chief lighting technician on a film set corrects an error.
explanation.definitionFit: On a film set the chief lighting technician carries this title.

clue.text: In such a state there's no need for alarm

definitions.text: In such a state there's no need for alarm

parts.words: In such a state there's no need for alarm
parts.note: seems to be about a calm situation, but the alarm is an alarm clock, unneeded by someone who cannot sleep anyway

explanation.surface: Things are calm, so nobody needs to worry.
explanation.definitionFit: Chronic sleeplessness means a person is awake before any clock rings.

clue.text: Does this reflect the elements?

parts.note: suggests a mirror that reflects light, but the elements are wind and rain, which this instrument indicates

explanation.surface: A question about whether a mirror shows the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A barometer is an instrument showing coming atmospheric conditions.

clue.text: This god turned back where East and West meet

indicators.note: turned back tells us to write the place name in reverse order

parts.note: the Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, the classic junction of West and East

explanation.surface: A deity changes direction at a crossroads of cultures.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeus is king of the gods in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Cold as some eels are said to be

indicators.note: said to be signals a word that sounds like the description of the eels

parts.note: jellied eels are a traditional East London dish

explanation.surface: Some eels are served chilled.
explanation.walkthrough: Jellied eels, eels set in their own stock, are a Cockney delicacy from London.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelid is a literary word for icy or freezing.

clue.text: Part of a nasty eye-lid

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a piece of the following words, taken unbroken

explanation.surface: A sore spot on someone's eyelid.
explanation.definitionFit: A painful inflamed swelling on the edge of the eyelid is a nasty feature of it.

clue.text: Lives wildly, producing social problems

indicators.note: wildly means the letters of lives are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Reckless living leads to trouble in society.
explanation.definitionFit: Ills afflicting society, such as crime and poverty, are its evils.

clue.text: Reprimanded severely for having spiked the drink

explanation.surface: Someone was told off for adding alcohol to a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To lace into someone is to scold them; a drink laced has had spirit secretly added.

clue.text: Pity a vital ingredient in New York seasonal entertainment

indicators.note: in places the mixed letters inside the abbreviation for the city
an ingredient is something mixed in, so the letters of pity a vital are blended

explanation.surface: Something vital is missing from a Christmas show in Manhattan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ingredient' turns PITY A VITAL into ATIVITYPLA, and 'in' puts that between N and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A school play telling the Christmas story is performed each festive season.

clue.text: Prison clique is causing trouble

parts.note: stir is slang for prison
a ring is a closed group or gang

explanation.surface: A gang inside a jail is stirring things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirring as in stirring it up means making mischief or provoking strife.

clue.text: Mr O'Casey crashed in American plane

indicators.note: crashed suggests wreckage, so the letters of Mr O'Casey are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man named O'Casey crashed while in an aircraft from the US.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plane' looks like an aircraft, but it is the tree: in North America the plane tree is called a sycamore.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage, the plane tree genus Platanus goes by this name.

clue.text: Breaking in by a burglar results in a criminal record

explanation.surface: A housebreaker's break-in ends up on a police file.
explanation.definitionFit: Unlawful breaking and entering; and, read literally, an unlawful item written in a ledger.

clue.text: The opposite of bustles-yet still worn

explanation.surface: Unlike Victorian bustles, a garment remains in fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bustles' looks like the old dress padding, but here it is a verb, hurries about; slacks, idles, is its opposite. Slacks are also trousers, unlike bustles still worn.
explanation.definitionFit: To slack is to idle, unlike one who hurries about; casual trousers remain in everyday wardrobes.

clue.text: Indiscreet bank official?

parts.note: one cashier who tells secrets is literally one who tells, as well as the clerk at a bank counter

explanation.surface: A bank clerk who gossips about clients.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank cashier counts out money; read literally, the word means one who tells.

clue.text: Vegetable in need of a plug, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the answer sounds like the word for a hole needing plugging

parts.note: a leak is a hole needing to be stopped up

explanation.surface: A vegetable patch has a hole that needs plugging.
explanation.definitionFit: A leek is an onion-family vegetable, the national emblem of Wales.

clue.text: Strangely eager to come to terms

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of eager appear in an odd order

explanation.surface: Someone is oddly keen to settle a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Reaching an accord, to concur with each other.

clue.text: Song needs a tuneful backing

indicators.note: backing signals that the word for a tune is read backwards

parts.note: an air is a tune, so tuneful points to air

explanation.surface: A song wants a melodious accompaniment.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo piece for voice in an opera.

clue.text: A good man rises to King and Emperor

indicators.note: in a down clue rises means the letters are read upwards, reversing them

parts.note: ST, saint, a good man
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A virtuous man ascends to become monarch and ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian emperor bore this title.

clue.text: Spirited match

explanation.surface: A lively contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Game means plucky and willing; a game is a contest or sporting fixture.

clue.text: Enormous leakage in fuel

indicators.note: in places the word for leakage inside the word for fuel

parts.note: coal is a fuel
leakage is a loss, as of gas or water

explanation.surface: A huge spill has occurred in the fuel supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Colossal means gigantic, like the Colossus of Rhodes.

clue.text: Group going round an evil gambling den

indicators.note: going round says the word for group surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: Co, company, a group
the indefinite article, A
sin is evil

explanation.surface: A gang encircles a wicked place where people bet.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino is a house where games of chance are played for money.

clue.text: Drunken purser is disposed to stagger

indicators.note: drunken means the letters of purser is reel about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An intoxicated ship's officer tends to sway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stagger' looks like the drunken purser's lurching, but it is a verb meaning astonish.
explanation.definitionFit: To stagger someone is to astonish them, to take them aback.

clue.text: Start breeding a bird dog

indicators.note: start points to the opening letter of breeding

parts.note: an eagle is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: Someone begins to breed a hunting dog that goes after birds.
explanation.definitionFit: A beagle is a small hound breed used in hunting hares.
